  SELECT sd.ART_link,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'context', 'display') IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'context', 'display') = 'Low' THEN 1

        CASE 
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'context', 'storage') = 'Low' THEN 1
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'context', 'storage') = 'Medium' THEN 5
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'context', 'storage') = 'High' THEN 10
          ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE 
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'biological', 'pest') = 'Low' THEN 1
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'biological', 'pest') = 'Medium' THEN 5
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'biological', 'pest') = 'High' THEN 10
          ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE 
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'light') = 'Low' THEN 1
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'light') = 'Medium' THEN 5
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'light') = 'High' THEN 10
          ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE 
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'humidity') = 'Low' THEN 1
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'humidity') = 'Medium' THEN 5
          WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, 'environment', 'humidity') = 'High' THEN 10

        END

)

  SELECT "ArtifactsCore"."ARTregID", "ArtifactsCore".ageYears, "ArtifactsCore".MatKind
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" 
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ON "ArtifactsCore"."ARTregID" = "ConditionAssessments".art_exam
),
showcase_env AS (
  SELECT ac.ARTregID, ac.ageYears, s.caseID, erc.TEMPc, erc.RH, lrr.lux, lrr.visLxh
  FROM artifact_showcase ac
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ac.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
  JOIN "Showcases" s ON ca.case_exam = s.caseID
  JOIN "Monitor_Showcase_Map" msm ON s.caseID = msm.case_ID
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" erc ON msm.mon_ID = erc.monitor_code AND erc.case_link = s.caseID
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" lrr ON erc.monitor_code = lrr.env_link
),
sensitivity_scores AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link",
    AVG(
      COALESCE(
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'display' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'display'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'storage' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'storage'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'biological'->>'pest' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'biological'->>'pest'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END
      , 0) / 6.0
    ) as erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT se.ARTregID, se.ageYears, ss.erf,
    se.lux, se.visLxh, se.TEMPc, se.RH,
    -- LER = (lux * Light Sensitivity Weight * visLxh) / 1000
    -- Light sensitivity weight from env_handling_sensitivity environment.light
    ROUND(CAST(
      se.lux * 
      CASE sd2."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END *
      se.visLxh / 1000.0
    AS numeric), 4) as ler,
    -- MDR = (ageYears * ERF * (RH - 50)^2 * TEMPc) / 100000
    ROUND(CAST(
      se.ageYears * ss.erf * POWER(se.RH - 50, 2) * se.TEMPc / 100000.0
    AS numeric), 4) as mdr
  FROM showcase_env se
  JOIN sensitivity_scores ss ON se.ARTregID = ss."ART_link"
  JOIN "SensitivityData" sd2 ON se.ARTregID = sd2."ART_link"
)
SELECT ARTregID, ROUND(CAST(erf + ler + (mdr * 2) AS numeric), 4) as tetl_score
FROM combined
ORDER BY tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'display'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'storage' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'context'->>'storage'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'biological'->>'pest' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'biological'->>'pest'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'light'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'humidity'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature' IN ('Low','Medium','High') THEN
          CASE sd."env_handling_sensitivity"->'environment'->>'temperature'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0 END

        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END *

    AS numeric), 4) as ler,
    ROUND(CAST(
      se."ageYears" * ss.erf * POWER(se."RH" - 50, 2) * COALESCE(se."TEMPc", 0) / 100000.0
    AS numeric), 4) as mdr

  JOIN "SensitivityData" sd2 ON se."ARTregID" = sd2."ART_link"
